decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 6 months from the date of this approval.  Failure to carry out the modifications to the existing outbuilding in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and hereby approved will result in enforcement action being implemented.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding shall be incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 108 Swan Road and shall be used for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling).
description: Retention of a single storey outbuilding for use as a gym/store to rear garden of the house
